nodes.description: msg.sender: external caller address used for ownership, manager, vault init and NFT pull authorization
block.timestamp: miner-controllable value consumed by the vault randomness generator
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.vaultId: identifier assigned from factory.numVaults() during init
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.manager: optional privileged account that overrides owner rights
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.assetAddress: ERC721/ERC1155 asset contract the vault pulls/pushes tokens to
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.vaultFactory: factory supplying fees, locks and fee distributor
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.eligibilityStorage: external eligibility module used for mint validation
OwnableUpgradeable._owner: administrator of vault, factory and beacon
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.feeDistributor: contract receiving mint/redeem/swap fees
PausableUpgradeable.isPaused mapping: per-operation lock flags
ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable._status: nonReentrant guard flag
UpgradeableBeacon._childImplementation: implementation address all beacon proxies delegate to
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.randNonce: incrementing nonce mixed into vault randomness
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.getRandomTokenIdFromVault: derives a random holding index from weak on-chain entropy
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.withdrawNFTsTo: removes NFTs from vault and transfers them to recipient
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.receiveNFTs: validates eligibility and pulls ERC721/ERC1155 tokens into vault
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.transferERC721: builds and issues an outbound call to the asset contract
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.transferFromERC721: pulls ERC721 tokens, special handling for CryptoKitties/Punks
NFTXVaultUpgradeable._chargeAndDistributeFees: transfers fees to distributor and triggers distribution
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.mintTo: nonReentrant mint entrypoint that pulls NFTs and mints vault tokens
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.redeemTo: nonReentrant redeem entrypoint that burns vault tokens and releases NFTs
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.swapTo: nonReentrant swap entrypoint withdrawing then receiving NFTs
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.flashLoan: flash-mint entrypoint that invokes an untrusted borrower callback
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.onlyPrivileged: requires msg.sender be owner or manager
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.onlyOwnerIfPaused: blocks operation when factory lock is set unless caller is owner
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.createVault: deploys a vault, registers it and initializes receivers
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.deployVault: creates a BeaconProxy vault and configures manager/owner
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.setVaultFees: writes per-vault fee struct, callable by owner or the vault itself
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.disableVaultFees: clears per-vault fee struct
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.setFeeDistributor: onlyOwner update of fee distribution target
NFTXVaultUpgradeable.assignDefaultFeatures: privileged toggle gated only by a hardcoded dev address
NFTXVaultFactoryUpgradeable.assignFees: one-shot initializer of default factory fees
Proxy._delegate: performs delegatecall to the resolved implementation with raw calldata
Proxy._fallback: resolves implementation and delegates on fallback/receive
BeaconProxy._setBeacon: stores beacon slot and optionally delegatecalls init data
BeaconProxy._implementation: reads beacon slot and queries childImplementation()
UpgradeableBeacon.upgradeChildTo: onlyOwner pointer to new child implementation
OwnableUpgradeable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner transfer of admin rights
OwnableUpgradeable.onlyOwner: access-control modifier comparing owner() with _msgSender()
ERC20Upgradeable._mint: increases supply and balance of recipient
ERC20Upgradeable._burn: decreases supply and balance of account
ERC20Upgradeable._transfer: moves vault tokens between accounts
keccak256 over blockhash/coinbase/difficulty/timestamp used as randomness seed
address(assetAddr).call(data) unchecked low-level call in transferERC721
address(assetAddr).call(data) low-level call in transferFromERC721 with attacker-influenced calldata
staticcall to punkIndexToAddress whose return is decoded before success is verified
delegatecall(gas(), implementation, ...) executing arbitrary implementation code in proxy storage
INFTXFeeDistributor(feeDistributor).distribute(vaultId) external call after fee transfer
IERC1155Upgradeable(assetAddress).safeBatchTransferFrom pull with receiver hook
IERC1155Upgradeable(assetAddress).safeTransferFrom push to arbitrary recipient
receiver.onFlashLoan(...) untrusted external callback during flash loan
tokenIds array parameter of mintTo/swapTo/receiveNFTs
amounts array parameter of mintTo/swapTo/receiveNFTs (ERC1155 quantities)
recipient address parameter of mintTo/redeemTo/swapTo
specificIds array parameter of redeemTo/swapTo/withdrawNFTsTo
IERC3156FlashBorrowerUpgradeable receiver parameter of flashLoan
randomIndex local computed in getRandomTokenIdFromVault before holdings.at()

normalization_plan.reason: tokenIds is only an input array consumed by receiveNFTs and should collapse into that core pull function
amounts is only an input array consumed by receiveNFTs and should collapse into that core pull function
the recipient address parameter is fully determined by mintTo and should merge into that core function
specificIds ultimately drives the withdrawNFTsTo selection loop and should merge into that core function
the receiver parameter is the untrusted callback target of flashLoan and should merge into that core function
randomIndex is a transient local of getRandomTokenIdFromVault and should merge into that core function
